decision_rule_fixed_here: Read the Thinking arm (SAEA-SLURP-TEST-SAMPLE-3010-MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR3-THINKING-SYSTEM-V1) against the SEALED successor-2 column (SAEA-SLURP-TEST-SAMPLE-3010-MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR2-COMPOSED-V1) on the same 3,010 rows, CROSS-FLIGHT (nothing is re-flown; no in-chain replicate by design). PRIMARY: official pooled SLU-F1 (slurp-slu-official-test), post-stratified natural mixture (equal-stratum beside it), paired per recording with a prompt-clustered bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20261014. GUARD: intent accuracy (scenario_action exact), same contrast. DECLARED NULL: |o| = the DEV P3.1 twin offset (SLU 0.6144 pp / intent 1.6 pp), borrowed, not measured on the sample. HARM MARGIN 2.5 pp. Verdict words are successor 2's: NEUTRAL iff the CI95 lower bound of (Thinking minus successor 2) on SLU-F1 and on intent is at or above -2.5 pp and the read is not HARM; HARM iff the CI95 upper bound on SLU-F1 or on intent is below -|o| (a resolved loss beyond the declared offset, owner decision 25); UNRESOLVED iff the lower bound is under -2.5 pp while neither HARM nor NEUTRAL. NOMINATED is NOT a registered outcome (claims_benefit false): a point above the bar and a CI95 lower bound above |o| are REPORTED beside the word as 'gain reported, not claimed' and would need their own replicated read. Reported beside, CONTEXT ONLY: per-intent and per-scenario tables in the post-stratified natural-mixture and equal-stratum weightings (58 intents), the recording-channel split, the cost table, per-node cap-hit / empty / forced-close counts. The verdict word is the coordinator's (owner decision 139). A milestone development read (owner decisions 28, 151, 301), never a test claim.
development_numbers_only: Every number is a milestone development number (owner decisions 28, 86, 151, 301); never a test claim and never the final read.
failure_policy: ONE ATTEMPT, EVER (owner decision 151; allowance milestone_rule; contracts.gate_exposure._ExposureAndCarrierMixin._require_final_report_attempt_budget). Stop and preserve on the first failure. There is NO recovery re-registration, NO resume-recovery (the E10 clause of the source cell does not apply to a final-report read run id: the gate refuses a second attempt of a read run id even as a recovery), no re-score, no re-projection of delivered bytes, no best-of, no row filtering and no roster, role-graph, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. A failed attempt consumes the milestone number; a further milestone needs a fresh run id in a SUCCESSOR allowance under a fresh coordinator report to the owner. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
